fixed target Q --[unanchored decompositions]--> (ell,d)^perp / one global scale

obligations.name: homogeneous static rank bound
obligations.evidence: Every replayable static row annihilates the nonzero factor-base log vector, so rank is at most K-1.
obligations.scope: Any order-n factor base in the cyclic P-256 subgroup.

obligations.name: fixed-target projective bound
obligations.evidence: Every augmented fixed-target row annihilates (ell,d), so rank is at most K and one global scale remains.
obligations.scope: Unanchored decompositions of one P-256 target.

obligations.name: complete finite control
obligations.evidence: All 400 projective Z/7Z log profiles and all 960400 coefficient vectors were checked with zero discrepancies.
obligations.scope: Cyclic order-seven group with four base logs and one target log.

obligations.name: P-256 algebra replay
obligations.evidence: 984 materialized P-256 equations replayed exactly; dual-modulus ranks reach 163, 164, and 165 at the registered stages.
obligations.scope: Synthetic deterministic log-labelled points, not the geometry-defined factor base.

obligations.name: two-equation P-256 event
obligations.evidence: No non-scalar-labelled event supplying both target coupling and an independent generator scale anchor is constructed.

obligations.name: complete below-rho recovery
obligations.evidence: The free one-anchor boundary is above rho and no new relation/decomposition/recovery pipeline exists.

controls: The toy census replayed 412400 cyclic-group equations with zero false positives, false negatives, or rank discrepancies.
Six P-256 stages were ranked over two fields in both row orders; 984 group equations replayed with zero failures.
Round 295, 298, 299, and 304 inputs were imported only after exact byte-hash, schema, curve, factor-base, width, and conclusion checks.
cost_accounting: Measured: complete toy coefficient enumeration, retained rows, rank operations, P-256 scalar multiplications, group additions, equation replays, process telemetry, and artifact sizes.
Imported without extrapolation: Round-304 unquotiented, unknown-anchor, and known-anchor oracle/direct ratios.

Unset: discovery of static identities on FB1hc72514a2a8d3, a target-coupling-plus-scale-anchor event, relation yield, structured solver, sparse linear algebra, target recovery, and complete attack cost.
exploration_boundary: Exact for static homogeneous group identities and unanchored fixed-target decompositions in a prime-order cyclic subgroup; not a lower bound on a mechanism that supplies target coupling and an independent generator scale anchor in one event.
weakest_open_obligation: Construct and replay one P-256 event that supplies both target coupling and an independent known generator right-hand side without secret scalar labels, then price its complete recovery pipeline below rho.
narrowest_supported_finding: Any free homogeneous structure on a 164-column P-256 factor base leaves at least one global log scale, and unanchored fixed-target decompositions remain projective. Full rank needs two post-static equations: target coupling plus one independent generator anchor, or two independent generator-anchored target rows.
